description: Builds a direct buy link an agent can hand to the user. IMPORTANT: SOMA is not in production yet — every order placed today is a PRE-ORDER, production starts after December 2026, and nothing ships before then. Say so when you surface this link. With Shopify variant IDs configured it returns a cart permalink that lands in checkout pre-filled; otherwise it returns the product page on the shop. Payment always happens on Shopify's checkout with the human in control — this tool never charges anyone.

format.description: Purchase format: smallCan = single 250ml can, can = single 500ml can, sixPack = 6 × 500ml cans
